app.name: WhatsApp for Zendesk
app.short_description: Templates and Brazilian contact review in the agent workspace.
app.long_description: Open source app under development. Organize existing approved templates by group, insert them into the editor, and review potential duplicate contacts. Advanced capabilities still require Sunshine Conversations and Meta integration.
app.installation_instructions: Install in a test account and connect WhatsApp using Zendesk's official setup wizard. Read the README before merging users.
